scope: Read-only source/package review and bounded read-only inspection of the local synthetic seed; no browser run or deployment by this reviewer
releaseAssemblyStatus: Pending separate verification: production root must be the baseline commit with only the explicit owner launcher inclusion; new implementation remains inside owner-test/runtime.json

checks.parentOwnerGate: Existing verified-owner accounting RPC plus auth.getUser revalidation and session identity checks
checks.childBoundary: Opaque-origin iframe, no allow-same-origin; parent messages require exact frame, null origin, channel and random nonce
checks.network: CSP connect-src none, default-src none and form-action none; fetch replacement only returns local generated bytes, embedded logo or data; SDK is synthetic adapter only
checks.persistence: Parent-owned IndexedDB checkpoints under current owner key. Exclusive Web Lock blocks concurrent owner test tabs. Lock remains held through pending persistence; child stores only synthetic seed/run data
checks.resetAndClose: Guide now uses OwnerTestHost.close/restart bridge; restart reconstructs iframe after confirmed deletion. Cleanup inventory includes drafts, preliminary mail, linked document metadata, simulation records and blobs
checks.pdf: All invoice generator output is wrapped with OEFENFACTUUR — NIET GELDIG on every page. Agreement generator checks synthetic terms source and adds OEFENOVEREENKOMST - NIET GELDIG. Attachment lookup uses communication document mapping and verifies PDF header/hash
checks.features: Only parent ownerTest flag true; member enrollment, billing planning and communications execution are bundled in sandbox, not activated in production root by this package
checks.packagedSourceHashMethod: SHA-256 after CRLF/CR to LF normalization, compared against all current source files

limitations: Static review is not a physical owner acceptance test.
Browser execution and exact browser identity are evidenced separately by the root agent; this reviewer did not run Edge or Chrome.
CSS zoom alone does not prove native browser zoom; any later native-zoom test requires its own evidence.
No actual email, push, production Auth, database, Storage or migration was exercised by this review.
Saved synthetic checkpoints can resume; browser storage eviction, private-mode deletion or manually clearing site data are not guaranteed recovery cases.
Only fixed synthetic examples should be entered. The local test form cannot classify whether arbitrary owner-entered text is real personal data.
limitsOfSeedInspection: Read-only synthetic marker, fixed Auth/profile email domain counts, financial/document zero counts and number-prefix check; source build uses only local fixtures. No production data or connection.
followUp: Rechecked after canonical planned/manual invoice lines fix and rebuilt frozen seed; existing package/network separation assertions rechecked, functional Edge final-PDF/mail tests run separately by root.
